goal: NS Cloud Drive — Fix Post-Restart VFS Cache Hash Divergence & Continuous Queue Liveness
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Eliminate dynamic environment config hashing: write static per-account INI config files ('mount-$mountKey.conf') with all backend properties (token, type, client_id, etc.) so rclone uses a permanent, static cache path ('vfs\$RemoteName') without '{hash}' curly braces.

2. Preserve staged bytes at mount time: keep the pre-mount reconciliation pass so historical dirty files and metadata remain intact, but default to preserve-only reconciliation. Copying into the live cache root is opt-in because rclone builds its upload queue once at mount start, so a post-mount copy can never be uploaded.
3. Fix RC vfs/refresh payload: Pass '{"recursive":"true"}' (string) with '_async="true"' to prevent rclone error 'value must be string "recursive"=true'.
4. Queue Liveness Watchdog: Detect un-indexed dirty files or stalled upload state and trigger directory touch/hydration so rclone continuously uploads until queue reaches 0.

5. Post-restart recovery without data loss: adopt the 165 staged files from the superseded cache root into the durable transfer queue, upload them from their staged location with remote verification, suppress settled revisions, and confirm pending counts reach 0 while every staged source file remains untouched.
6. Idempotency & Quality: Regression tests pass with exit code 0; zero raw unicode in NSCloudDrive.ps1; Set-StrictMode -Version Latest compliant; zero data loss.

decisions.decision: Use static per-account INI config files instead of passing credentials via RCLONE_CONFIG_* environment variables.
decisions.rationale: Passing backend credentials via env vars causes rclone to hash parameters and create changing '{hash}' cache directories on restart or token refresh. Static INI files produce permanent, static cache directories ('vfs\gdrive').

decisions.decision: Run Sync-VirtualDriveOrphanedVfsCache immediately prior to rclone process start in Start-VirtualDriveMount.
decisions.rationale: Rclone only reads local disk cache once during startup readCache(). Placing all dirty files into the static target directory before process launch guarantees rclone queues them immediately.

decisions.decision: Make orphan reconciliation preserve-only by default; copying into the live cache root requires the explicit -CopyIntoActiveCache switch.
decisions.rationale: A hermetic experiment showed a dirty file copied into a running mount's cache root is never ingested (rclone still reported 'to upload 0' after 26 seconds). Copying 3.3 GB into an unread directory would duplicate staged data without uploading anything, and the previous behavior removed source copies on metadata/size heuristics.

decisions.decision: Adopt staged files that live outside the active rclone cache root into the durable transfer queue and upload them from their staged path.
decisions.rationale: The live mount moved from 'vfs\gdrive' to 'vfs\gdrive{z0wI1}', so the 165 staged files are invisible to the running rclone process. Uploading them through the application's own queue with remote verification is the only recovery path that does not depend on an rclone remount, and it never moves or deletes the staged source.

decisions.decision: Fail closed when the active cache root is unknown, and never adopt files inside it.
decisions.rationale: rclone owns the files in the live root; a second uploader racing it would risk duplicate or interleaved writes. Without a mounted account there is no trustworthy root, so nothing is adopted.

decisions.decision: Suppress a staged duplicate only when its size and staged write time exactly match a completed, remotely verified job revision.
decisions.rationale: Keeps pending counts honest without hiding genuinely newer dirty revisions written after the confirmation.

decisions.decision: Persist settled staged revisions in the durable queue file, independently of completed jobs.
decisions.rationale: Adoption preserves every staged source, so clearing the completed list would delete the only evidence of remote confirmation and the next adoption pass would re-upload all 165 files (3.3 GB). Settlement evidence is harvested before completed jobs are removed and reloaded with the queue.

decisions.decision: Require every queue-writing test suite to redirect the durable queue path into %TEMP%.
decisions.rationale: Test-TransferBandwidthAndQueue.ps1 was writing 120 synthetic jobs into the live %LOCALAPPDATA% queue 128 times, leaving 128 atomic backups and contaminating production state.

securityFindings: Generated rclone mount config for Google Drive still contains a plaintext token that rclone refreshes roughly 4 seconds after mount; queue snapshots and the application config writer already omit credential fields. Tracked separately from the transfer-recovery work.
blockers: Live recovery verification requires a controlled application restart and remount; not performed without approval.
Real-provider upload of the 165 staged files requires explicit approval.
No genuine Windows reboot test and no live TeraBox upload test were performed.

NS Cloud Drive — Transfer Direction, Identity, and VFS Hydration Defects
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Transfer direction resolved exclusively from explicit account providers (local/gdrive/terabox), never from drive letters, file names, extensions, UI labels, or working directories.
2. Unknown or empty provider fails closed to 'Needs reconciliation: operation unresolved'; jobs are preserved but never scheduled with guessed direction.
3. Every queue job persists OperationType, Direction, SourceProvider, DestinationProvider, SourceAccountId, DestinationAccountId, Origin, TransferKey, and SourceLastWriteUtc.
4. Dedup by TransferKey; terminal jobs not revived implicitly (-AllowNewAttempt required).
5. Legacy records migrate operation/direction from persisted endpoints on load; missing endpoints fail closed.
6. VFS stats determine direction per transfer item from srcFs/dstFs; new VfsCacheHydration label for cloud→local read-through; no Pause/Cancel for hydration.
7. Stop-ActiveTransfer restores bandwidth to 'off' after cancellation (no lingering 1 B/s cap).
9. Resume-CloudTransferQueueItem blocks completed jobs, revalidates operation, resets verification retries.
10. Transfer Center shows Direction, OperationType, endpoints, account IDs, and Origin; reconciliation states visually distinct.
11. 14-case regression suite (Test-TransferDirectionAndIdentity.ps1) passes exit 0; all affected existing suites pass exit 0.
12. Zero raw multi-byte unicode in NSCloudDrive.ps1; Set-StrictMode -Version Latest compliant; parser-validated.

decisions.decision: Transfer direction is a property of each transfer item, resolved from srcFs/dstFs for VFS activity and from account providers for queue jobs — never inferred from mount-wide counters.
decisions.rationale: Mount-wide upload counters mislabeled cloud→local read-through hydration as uploads; path-shape inference changes direction on restart when endpoints are incomplete.

decisions.decision: VfsCacheHydration items expose no Pause/Cancel; rclone has no per-file cancel API and the only lever (mount-wide throttle) is unsafe for individual files.
decisions.rationale: The user's Cancel click on hydration triggered transfer-cancel but the activity was rclone VFS read-through, not a download job. Offering cancel for hydration is misleading.

decisions.decision: rclone-owned \vfs\ and \vfsMeta\ files are excluded from app-level eviction; --vfs-cache-max-age/--vfs-cache-max-size remain authoritative.
decisions.rationale: App-level eviction of rclone read-cache files caused 'detected external removal of cache file' and immediate re-download, producing apparent repeated transfers.

decisions.decision: Stop-ActiveTransfer restores bandwidth to 'off' after cancel; a lingering 1 B/s cap silently cripples all later mount activity.
decisions.rationale: The previous code left the throttle at 1 B/s after cancellation, affecting every subsequent read and upload on the mount.

decisions.decision: Legacy records with missing endpoints are preserved but fail closed to 'Needs reconciliation: operation unresolved'; they are never scheduled with a guessed direction.
decisions.rationale: Direction guessing on incomplete state caused the TeraBox→local video to be misclassified as a download and the repeated-transfer defect.
